verdict.rationale: Pilot is a bookkeeping, tax and CFO service, and its portal includes an AI-answers feature. A product like that could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any way to plug in MCP servers or let its AI use external tools; the documented integrations (Bill.com, Stripe, Gusto) are financial-data connectors, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
